Risk_Statement: The AI assistant may access more customer or operational data than necessary for its approved purpose
Cause: Incomplete access scoping or overly broad Microsoft 365 permissions
Potential_Impact: Exposure of confidential customer operational or pricing information
Recommended_Treatment: Perform formal access review and restrict the assistant to approved repositories and groups

Risk_Statement: The AI assistant may draft inaccurate customer communications or work-order notes
Cause: AI-generated output may be based on incomplete outdated or misunderstood source material
Potential_Impact: Customer confusion operational errors reputational damage or rework
Existing_Controls: CTRL-004 Human Approval; CTRL-006 Source Currency
Recommended_Treatment: Require human approval for all customer-facing or operationally binding outputs and review source currency
Notes: Do not permit direct customer sending during pilot

Risk_Statement: The AI assistant may be used to perform or recommend restricted business actions without proper review
Cause: Unclear action boundaries or weak workflow controls
Potential_Impact: Unauthorized purchases billing changes refunds contract changes or dispatch decisions
Existing_Controls: CTRL-003 Action Boundaries; CTRL-004 Human Approval
Recommended_Treatment: Document prohibited actions and test workflows against restricted action attempts
Notes: Action boundary controls must be validated before production

Risk_Statement: The organization may be unable to reconstruct why an AI-assisted output was produced or approved
Cause: Insufficient prompt output source reference approval and activity logging
Potential_Impact: Weak audit trail incident investigation gaps and reduced accountability
Recommended_Treatment: Retain prompt output source references user identity approval notes and related activity logs
Notes: Evidence design should support audit and incident review

Risk_Statement: The AI system may lack clear accountable owners for business technical and data decisions
Cause: AI pilot launched without formal governance assignment
Potential_Impact: Delayed risk decisions unclear escalation and poor lifecycle management
Recommended_Treatment: Maintain named business technical and data owners in the AI system inventory
Notes: Initial ownership is implemented but should be reviewed

Risk_Statement: The AI assistant may rely on outdated service procedures or vendor documentation
Cause: Weak document lifecycle management or stale SharePoint content
Potential_Impact: Incorrect recommendations service errors and technician rework
Recommended_Treatment: Review approved source repositories and remove outdated documents from AI-accessible locations
Notes: Align with SharePoint governance and document review practices
